Kudlow, Mnuchin, Ross test negative for COVID
Mnuchin and Pelosi continue stimulus negotiations

White Advisor Larry Kudlow
tells FOX Business he has tested negative for COVID-19.
In an interview with Stuart Varney he noted he will continue daily testing, along with other White House officials.
His disclosure comes as U.S. Treasury Secretary
Steven Mnuchin
also tested negative for
COVID-19
as did Commerce Secretary Wilbur Ross, FOX Business has confirmed.
The disclosures come after President Trump and first lady Melania tested positive.
Treasury spokesperson Monica Crowley, in a tweet, announced the testing is part of a daily routine Mnuchin undergoes.
Mnuchin, earlier this morning, wished Trump and the first lady a "speedy recovery" after both tested positive for COVID-19.
U.S. stocks, while lower, trimmed losses midday Friday.
